assets.semanticBrief: Universal realm gold denomination used in bags, banks, trade, markets, and vendors; must read as warm gold at the 11px coin crop.
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a single opaque square micro-currency icon for a premium classic dark-fantasy MMORPG UI. Paint one complete tangible token as the only subject, centered and near-front with a slight three-quarter tilt, circular silhouette, generous safe padding, about 72 percent of the square. Premium hand-painted fantasy game art, tactile minted material, controlled brush texture, crisp focal relief and softer outer vignette, warm top-left key light and cool bottom-right shadow. Fully opaque deep charcoal-navy painted background, no scene. Designed to stay unmistakable at 128, 48, 32, 16, and 11 pixels and inside a circular CSS crop: use a bold simple silhouette and thick readable relief. A physical raised coin rim is allowed, but no baked UI frame or icon border. Exactly one object. No stack, extra coins, hands, characters, text, letters, numbers, pseudo-writing, alphabetic glyphs, watermark, signature, transparency, checkerboard, UI chrome, rarity frame, photorealism, raw 3D render, or flat vector style. Subject: a rich warm 22-karat gold realm coin with convincing gold color, lightly worn ridged edge, and a large bold crowned eight-ray sun embossed in high relief. Make the crown-and-sun read as one strong heraldic shape even in grayscale; restrained amber gleam, dark recesses, tiny age marks, no gemstones.

decision.colorScales: pass: warm gold and crowned radial sun remain distinct through 11px
decision.grayscale: pass: radial relief separates from crescent and organic leaf denominations
decision.circularCrop: pass: complete rim and dark safety ring remain visible at every reviewed scale
